name: mcp-postgres-server
description: MCP server for PostgreSQL: local, Docker, RDS, Neon, Supabase, or behind an SSH bastion.
long_description:
Connects an agent to a PostgreSQL database. It reaches local and Docker databases, managed Postgres on RDS, Neon and Supabase, and a database that is only available through an SSH bastion, with the bastion host key pinned.

Writes are off by default and are refused by PostgreSQL itself, not by a client-side SQL filter: every read runs inside a `BEGIN READ ONLY` transaction, so the rule survives views, rules and functions. Turn writes on with one setting.

Results carry a byte budget, so a large table does not flood the context window. Failures come back as readable messages carrying the SQLSTATE or SSH error code with a hint, so the agent can correct itself.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query and return the rows.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List the schemas visible to the connected user.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List the tables in a schema.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Describe a table: columns, types, nullability, defaults and primary key.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run a write statement. Disabled unless writes are enabled.

database_url.title: Database URL
database_url.description: Connection string, for example postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db?sslmode=require. With an SSH bastion below, the host is resolved from the bastion's network.

allow_write.title: Allow writes
allow_write.description: Off by default: the execute tool is present but refuses writes, and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction. On: execute performs INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and DDL.

max_result_bytes.title: Result byte budget
max_result_bytes.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept up to the budget; over it, the result is flagged as truncated.

statement_timeout.title: Statement timeout (ms)
statement_timeout.description: Per-statement timeout applied to every session.

ssh_host.title: SSH bastion host
ssh_host.description: Optional. Setting it routes the database connection through an SSH tunnel to this host. Leave empty for a directly reachable database.

ssh_private_key.title: SSH private key
ssh_private_key.description: Private key file for the bastion. If empty, authentication falls back to a running SSH agent, then to a default key in ~/.ssh.

ssh_fingerprint.title: SSH host fingerprint
ssh_fingerprint.description: Pinned host key of the bastion, as SHA256:... . Required when tunneling: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Read it with ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 HOST | ssh-keygen -lf -
